source.directorySummary: Implements bottomup.summarize subcommands that define CLI options, adapt parsed options to orchestration, and handle candidate collection, coverage validation, hash-based summary reuse, AI-synthesized hierarchical summaries, and draft/plan lifecycle for .BOTTOMUP.json updates with typed schemas and hashing.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapts parsed CLI/web options into BottomupSummarize calls and delegates to executeBottomupSummarize, reviseBottomupSummarizeDraft, and acceptBottomupSummarizeDraft with workspace-root resolution and draft rendering.

ai.ts.sourceSummary: Builds a constrained prompt from directorySourceSummary, child summaries, and incomplete coverage and invokes the generate prompt agent to return a validated {summary} JSON response.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Declares SubcommandDefinitions for bottomup.summarize and hidden bottomup.summarize.revise/accept with path, root, prompt, model, ignore, gitignore/hidden, draft, plan and state options.

handler.test.ts.sourceSummary: Exercises bottom-up summarization including child aggregation without source reads, hash-current skipping, partial/strict coverage handling, agent-supplied summaries, planning, and draft lifecycle validation.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Orchestrates candidate collection, coverage validation, hash-based summary and coverage reuse, AI/agent-derived synthesis, plan calculation, and draft state encoding/decoding and acceptance for hierarchical .BOTTOMUP.json updates.

hash.ts.sourceSummary: Computes deterministic summary input and summary hashes via hashValue from BOTTOMUP_SUMMARY_VERSION, source inputHash/directorySummary, child path/inputHash/value, and coverage.

types.ts.sourceSummary: Defines Zod schemas and TypeScript types for the summarize AI response, resolved options, candidates, plans, draft state, and written/plan/draft results.

summary.value: CLI layer for `bottomup.summarize` that defines options, adapts parsed options to orchestration, and manages candidate collection, coverage validation, hash-based summary reuse, AI-synthesized hierarchical summaries, and .BOTTOMUP.json draft/plan lifecycle with typed schemas and hashing; delegates draft modal presentation to `renderers` child which displays change counts/diffs with revise/accept/decline actions.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Hierarchical synthesis tier of the bottom-up knowledge pipeline beneath plugins/file/commands — aggregates leaf and child directory summaries produced by bottomup.generate into parent-level .BOTTOMUP.json entries. Relies on the shared bottomup infrastructure (inherited effective context, SHA-256 inputHash/summary hashing, coverage validation, and plan/draft/revise/accept lifecycle) defined at the commands container level, and complements bottomup.enrich/summary consumers; owns prompt-driven AI synthesis and deterministic reuse locally while delegating interactive draft review to the renderers child.

files.adapter.ts: Boundary translation layer between the centralized file dispatcher (adapter.ts/handleFile) and the summarize orchestration core; normalizes CLI/web option shapes, resolves workspace root, and fans out to execute/revise/accept handler calls with renderer-backed draft modal presentation.
files.ai.ts: Isolated prompt-construction and validation adapter for hierarchical synthesis; composes constrained prompt from directorySourceSummary, child summaries and incomplete coverage signals and enforces the Zod-validated {summary} contract via the generate prompt agent before returning to handler.
files.definition.ts: Declarative CLI contract for this subcommand family; registers the visible bottomup.summarize command and hidden revise/accept lifecycle companions and defines the shared path/root/prompt/model/ignore/gitignore/draft/plan option schema consumed by adapter and handler.
files.handler.test.ts: Out-of-band verification harness not on the runtime dispatch path; guards orchestration invariants for child aggregation without source reads, hash-current skipping, strict/partial coverage handling, agent-supplied summaries and draft lifecycle without touching live AI or filesystem.
files.handler.ts: Core orchestration authority owning the end-to-end summarize pipeline — candidate collection → coverage validation → hash-based reuse → AI/agent synthesis → plan calculation → draft state encode/decode/accept — and the hierarchical .BOTTOMUP.json mutation and caching decisions.
files.hash.ts: Deterministic content-addressing primitive for reuse optimization; computes versioned summary input and summary hashes from BOTTOMUP_SUMMARY_VERSION, directorySourceSummary/inputHash, child hashes and coverage, mirroring the strategy used by bottomup.generate at directory scope.
files.types.ts: Shared contract hub for the synthesize lifecycle; centralizes Zod schemas and TypeScript types for AI response, resolved options, candidates, plans and draft/written results that bind adapter, handler, AI, hash and renderers.
